name: textportico-monorepo
description: Text Portico — dev SMS capture, Web UI, and HTTP notify (monorepo)

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @textportico/web build && pnpm --filter @textportico/core build && pnpm --filter @textportico/provider-twilio build
scripts.publish:packages: pnpm run build && pnpm publish --filter @textportico/core --filter @textportico/provider-twilio --access public --no-git-checks
